scope: Exploratory SHARE-seq full QC-passing population (31890 paired cells), with constants transferred unchanged from selected SNARE-10000 configurations; not tuned or selected on SHARE-seq
order: FW then KL for even seed-list index; KL then FW for odd index
resource_gate: All pilot rank/phase reserved-memory peaks below 80% of device memory and summed rank process RSS peaks below 80% of 128GiB
storage: Save raw and rounded final coupling shards for six final runs, approximately48.8GB total; pilot plans validated and hashed without persistence
loss: Original full unregularized squared-loss GW with no half factor; exact distributed diagnostics and float64 final validation
output: Current iterate rounded at recorded checkpoints; no incumbent selection
timing: Same four GPUs sequentially for each paired method; communication counts toward solver time; also report four times solver time and total allocated GPU-hours
interpretation: Three stochastic repetitions of one fixed paired dataset; no biological alignment or asymptotic speedup claim implied
population: All 31890 paired cells passing the unchanged joint QC, with no subsampling
